contentPattern.structure: question label + answer paragraph per row (7 collapsible Q&A items)

suitableFor: collapsible lists of related topics presented in a compact, scannable format
help / support content where users selectively expand details
notSuitableFor: content that should all be visible at once without interaction
tabbed category switching between listing grids (use tabs-adventures)
repeating image + title + description grids (use cards-article)

similarityEvaluation.reason: No existing accordion-based variant in the project (scanned blocks/ for accordion*; existing custom variants are cards-*, carousel-*, columns-*, hero-*, tabs-*). Best similarity score is 0, below the 0.8 threshold, so a new variant was created from the Block Collection 'accordion' block.

usage.notes: WKND FAQs accordion: 7 expandable questions (audience, funding, contributing, update cadence, founding, hot-dog-sandwich, real-company) each revealing an answer paragraph. moveInstrumentation import/call removed from vanilla accordion.js since this is a doc (non-xwalk) project and that helper is not present in scripts.js. JS class names updated from base 'accordion-item*' to 'accordion-faq-item*' to match the renamed CSS.
